To investigate it, this work presents the first systematic study on object hallucination of LVLMs.
Generation of plausible yet incorrect factual information, termed hallucination, is an unsolved issue in large language models.

Abstract While large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated remarkable capabilities across a range of downstream tasks, a significant concern revolves around their propensity to exhibit hallucinatio
We conduct the evaluation experiments on several representative LVLMs, and show that they mostly suffer from severe object hallucination issues.
Large language models (LLMs), such as Chat-GPT, are prone to generate hallucinations, i.e., content that conflicts with the source or cannot be verified by the factual knowledge.
